113.sql: SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 Name FROM dye.h_Employee WHERE EmpID = @EmpID ORDER BY Name DESC) = c.Creater THEN N'不能审核自己创建的调整单据' WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 Name FROM dye.h_Employee WHERE EmpID = @EmpID ORDER BY Name DESC) = c.Modifyer THEN N'不能审核自己修改的调整单据' ELSE NULL END AS original_message FROM (SELECT SheetSeries AS SheetSeries, SheetNo AS SheetNo, Creater AS Creater, Modifyer AS Modifyer FROM dye.SalaryChanges WHERE SheetSeries = @SheetSeries) c ORDER BY c.[SheetSeries],c.[SheetNo],c.[Creater],c.[Modifyer]

53.sql: SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 b.ClassID FROM dye.p_ShiftEmp AS a LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift AS b ON a.ShiftID = b.ShiftID WHERE @ActionTime >= b.StratDate AND @ActionTime <= b.EndDate AND b.StationID = '09' AND a.EmpID = @EmpID ORDER BY b.ClassID, b.ShiftID), '') = '' THEN N'登录人没有排班，不能审核' WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 b.ClassID FROM dye.p_ShiftEmp AS a LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift AS b ON a.ShiftID = b.ShiftID WHERE @ActionTime >= b.StratDate AND @ActionTime <= b.EndDate AND b.StationID = '09' AND a.EmpID = @EmpID ORDER BY b.ClassID, b.ShiftID) = '04' AND NOT (DATEPART(HOUR, CAST(@ActionTime AS DATETIME)) < 8 OR DATEPART(HOUR, CAST(@ActionTime AS DATETIME)) >= 20) THEN N'当前时间为白班，登录人排夜班，不能审核' WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 b.ClassID FROM dye.p_ShiftEmp AS a LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift AS b ON a.ShiftID = b.ShiftID WHERE @ActionTime >= b.StratDate AND @ActionTime <= b.EndDate AND b.StationID = '09' AND a.EmpID = @EmpID ORDER BY b.ClassID, b.ShiftID) <> '04' AND (DATEPART(HOUR, CAST(@ActionTime AS DATETIME)) < 8 OR DATEPART(HOUR, CAST(@ActionTime AS DATETIME)) >= 20) THEN N'当前时间为夜班，登录人排白班，不能审核' ELSE NULL END AS original_message FROM (SELECT 1 AS present) c ORDER BY c.[present]

59.sql: SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.P_ColorNum AS p WHERE dye.F_Get_No(p.ColorNum) = dye.F_Get_No(c.ColorNum) AND p.ProdID = c.ProdID) THEN N'下单色号、布种与化验室打样资料不对应' ELSE NULL END AS original_message FROM (SELECT a.SheetNo AS OrderSheetNo, b.CheckNo AS CheckNo, b.ColorNum AS ColorNum, b.CustFabricName AS ProdID, p.NameC AS NameC FROM dye.OrderMain AS a INNER JOIN dye.OrderColor AS b ON a.SheetSeries = b.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN dye.p_Product AS p ON b.CustFabricName = p.ProdID WHERE a.SheetSeries = @SheetSeries) c ORDER BY c.[OrderSheetNo],c.[CheckNo],c.[ColorNum],c.[ProdID],c.[NameC]
